basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, who works remotely as a software developer. Enjoys building custom PCs and staying up-to-date with the latest technology trends. Loves gaming, especially first-person shooters and survival games like Rust. Dislikes unnecessary complexity in builds and prefers practical solutions. Typically online during late evenings and weekends. In a long-term relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a background in computer science with a degree from a local university. Self-taught in building PCs through online forums, YouTube tutorials, and trial-and-error over the past decade. Works professionally as a software developer, which keeps them engaged with the latest technology.
